knownIssues: External OIDC: MCP_AUTH_ISSUER/JWKS validation works, but mapping external subjects to platform users (JIT provisioning) and a full OAuth authorization-server integration for MCP hosts are not implemented; MVP uses built-in login and personal agent tokens
AI adapter not tested against the live Anthropic API in this environment (no key); behaviour verified with a fake LLM and fallbacks
Default embeddings are a deterministic hashing model (weak semantics); configure EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=http for a learned model
MCP App view bundle is ~600 KiB (ext-apps SDK includes its schema layer)
Rate limiting is in-process (per instance); use a shared store or gateway when scaling out
Large video uploads go through the API (50 MB limit); presigned direct-to-storage uploads and speech-to-text are not implemented
PostgreSQL row-level security not enabled (tenant isolation is enforced in application/repositories)
Docker images run TypeScript via tsx; no bundling/slim runtime image yet; GitHub Actions workflow not yet executed on GitHub
Claim editing UI in the web workspace supports create/publish/retract; revision editing is API-only

Ontology: the cybersecurity facet default level is 'experience', which also applies to mechanisms (SecOC, HSM, secure boot); a bare 'SecOC stack' requirement rates an IMPLEMENTS SecOC claim as partial. Consider per-concept default levels (data) for mechanisms
MCP supplier tools have no revise/retract/delete for drafts or update_offering; unwanted drafts simply stay private (edit in the web workspace or API)
Terms of use and privacy notice pages are drafts and must be replaced by counsel-approved text before external users are invited
Unverified buyer organizations can send engagement requests; mitigated by invite-only registration during the pilot
